user.title: Connect your FoxESS inverter
user.description: Create an API key in FoxESS Cloud under User Profile > API Management. The device serial is the inverter SN shown under Devices. The plan sensors are the ones EMHASS publishes.

data_description.emhass_entity: Usually sensor.p_batt_forecast. Its battery_scheduled_power attribute is the plan.
data_description.emhass_grid_entity: Usually sensor.p_grid_forecast. Used to tell grid charging from PV surplus charging.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the FoxESS Cloud API.
error.device_not_found: FoxESS does not know this serial number on the account that owns the API key.
error.rate_limited: The FoxESS API request limit for today is exhausted. Try again after midnight.
error.invalid_response: FoxESS rejected the request. Check the API key and serial number.
error.no_scheduler: This inverter does not report mode scheduler support, so it cannot be controlled.

rate_limited.title: FoxESS API request limit exhausted
rate_limited.description: The FoxESS Cloud Open API allows 1440 requests per inverter and day and that quota is used up. The bridge pauses all API calls and resumes at {resume_at}. If this happens regularly, check for other integrations or scripts using the same API key.
